The main takeaway from our work is that

the compositional distribution within a perovskite device is a critical parameter in achieving high quantum efficiency, and that a quasi core/shell architecture can provide the necessary control over the compositional distribution.
the composition of a perovskite film is an important design parameter for achieving efficient LEDs.
the quantum efficiency of perovskites is limited by nonradiative defects and that the use of an additive to passivate these defects is an effective approach to achieving high efficiency.
